one_line: Mughal emperor Aurangzeb overseeing the arduous siege of Bijapur, 1685–1686.

appearance.age_look: Mid- to late 60s, lean and slightly stooped, wiry build that still moves with controlled purpose.
appearance.face: Long, narrow face with a high forehead, sharp nose, and deep-set almond eyes; wheatish-brown North Indian complexion; neatly combed long grey beard split into two tapering sections; default expression calm, intent and austere, with slightly downturned brows suggesting strict focus.
appearance.hair: Hair mostly hidden beneath a tall white Mughal turban (dastar) wrapped smooth and high, with a narrow red band at the base and a single slim emerald-green sarpech-style plume pinned on the right; any visible hair at the temples is grey and neatly trimmed.
appearance.costume: Long-sleeved, calf-length cotton jama in muted ivory white with fine vertical pale-gold stripes, overlapping and tying to the right, worn over a deep maroon patka (waist sash) that wraps twice and knots at the side with the ends hanging; straight, tapered churidar trousers in soft moss-green gathering at the ankles; simple pointed leather mojari shoes in dark brown with minimal stitching; over the jama, a sleeveless, light-weight quilted armour vest (zarbaff-like) in dull beige with a faint diamond quilting pattern, slim enough to read practical not bulky; a discreet tasbih (prayer beads) of small dark-brown wooden beads coils once around his left wrist; no ostentatious jewellery beyond a small plain silver ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A rolled campaign farman (royal order) in cream-coloured parchment bound with a thin red ribbon, held in his right hand or tucked into his maroon waist sash, symbolising his authority over the siege rather than direct swordplay.

ref_desc: Aurangzeb is a lean, grey-bearded older man with a long face and calm austere expression, wearing a tall white turban with a green plume, an ivory-and-gold striped jama, maroon sash, moss-green churidar, beige quilted vest, brown mojari shoes, and holding a rolled cream farman with red ribbon.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Aurangzeb at the Bijapur siege: a mid-to-late-60s, lean Mughal emperor with a long narrow face, wheatish complexion, sharp nose, deep-set almond eyes, and a neatly parted long grey beard, his expression calm, intent and austere. He wears a tall smooth white Mughal turban with a narrow red band at the base and a single slim emerald-green plume pinned on the right. His outfit is a long-sleeved, calf-length cotton jama in muted ivory white with fine vertical pale-gold stripes, overlapping and fastening to the right, cinched with a deep maroon patka wrapped twice around his waist, knotted at the side with the ends hanging. Underneath are straight, tapered moss-green churidar trousers gathered at the ankles, and on his feet simple pointed dark-brown leather mojari shoes. Over the jama he has a sleeveless, light beige quilted armour vest with a subtle diamond pattern, slim and practical rather than bulky. A coil of dark wooden prayer beads rests around his left wrist, and a plain silver ring is on his right hand. His signature prop is a rolled cream-colored campaign farman tied with a thin red ribbon, which he holds in his right hand or has tucked into his maroon sash; present him from multiple angles to clearly show his face, turban, beard, layered garments, and color palette of ivory, pale gold, maroon, moss green, beige, and dark brown.
